taste:
This is a smaller serving of breaded scampi built around the contrast between a crisp coating and tender seafood. The whole-tail scampi is described as sweet and plump, with golden breadcrumbs providing the crunch. Tartare sauce brings a tangy counterpoint to the richness, so it is worth trying a little with the scampi rather than leaving it untouched.

Chips and garden peas make this a complete plate rather than just a smaller helping of seafood. The dish is described as served hot, with the same flavour focus as the larger Whitby Breaded Scampi. Choose it for the breaded texture and smaller serving, not on the assumption that a smaller meal has a verified low calorie total.

The value here is a smaller complete meal at a typical {price}, rather than a promise of the lowest cost. Chips, garden peas and tartare sauce are included, so there is no need to add a side simply to complete the plate. Prices vary by pub.

Compare it with Whitby Breaded Scampi if appetite matters more than portion restraint, or Small Battered Cod and Chips if you prefer battered fish. Fish Friday pricing is noted for Fridays, but check the local price and any eligible meal-with-drink option before ordering.
